summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 annual meeting materials (Notice of Meeting, Management Information Circular, and form of proxy) along with a waiver/acknowledgement from the Province of Ontario. The meeting is scheduled for June 9, 2026, as a virtual-only event. Business includes receiving audited financials, electing directors, appointing auditors, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. No merger, tender, restructuring, or special-situation catalyst is present. This is a routine Canadian proxy circular furnished under the 1934 Act; it maps to a U.S. annual meeting notice of no special-situation import. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved.
